theory.target: Audit exactness and positive Ext in the purely inseparable diagonal obstruction, using nilpotent versus separable controls; no general homotopy-colimit comparison theorem.
definitions: R=Fp[e]/e^m; v(f) is least nonzero coefficient index and v(0)=m.
Alternating multiplication by f,g is a complex when fg=0; positive homology is kernel modulo adjacent image.
Augmentation is z->0; Ext is computed by applying Hom to an exact free resolution.
Unrestricted singleton arrow-depth is zero; diagonal pieces are exterior products of perfect modules.
assumptions: For the universal obstruction k=Fp(t), t transcendental, L=k[u]/(u^p-t), and tensors are over k.
Finite arithmetic is over Fp and can scalar-extend to L; no inseparable finite-field extension is claimed.
Finite enumeration does not prove the arbitrary-degree Ext or general categorical comparison.
approaches_considered: Principal-ideal valuation classification and exact index census.
Direct quotient arithmetic and modular matrix ranks for independent verification.
Periodic maps or their ranks alone as a proposed obstruction certificate, rejected without exactness and Hom checks.
falsification_targets: Separable control with same ranks and vanishing positive Ext.
Missing field, tensor-base or perfect-piece hypothesis in the universal proof.

claims.statement: The proposed implication fg=0 implies exactness is false: in F2[e]/e^3 the pair f=g=e^2 has zero composition and homology dimension one.
claims.falsification_condition: Wrong quotient multiplication, kernel or image for the explicit pair.

claims.statement: For all 67,780 pairs in the frozen range, exactly 1,640 form complexes and 1,157 are exact. Full complex/exact index sets and homology histograms agree between implementations.
claims.falsification_condition: A missing tuple, wrong index or any independent matrix/valuation disagreement.

claims.statement: Eight nilpotent/separable augmented-algebra controls have ranks (p-1,1) but different positive Ext: nilpotent profile all ones, separable profile (1,0,...,0), through degree 12. Splitting idempotents and Frobenius coefficients are checked.
claims.falsification_condition: An incorrect quotient product, cochain rank, idempotent identity, or Frobenius coefficient within the frozen range.

claims.statement: For k=Fp(t), L=k[u]/(u^p-t), the ordinary proof reconstructs the imported depth-zero/non-perfect diagonal obstruction via nonzero Ext in all degrees. This universal argument remains UNVERIFIED by an independent author or kernel.
claims.falsification_condition: Failure of irreducibility, tensor presentation, exactness, arbitrary-degree Ext, or the allowed perfect exterior-product diagonal definition.

claims.statement: Stacks 09HD supports the field construction; Bai-Cote v3 Lemmas 2.13 and 2.15 support separate Rouquier bounds, not the imported positive diagonal gluing formula. AIM page unavailable.
claims.falsification_condition: Wrong primary locator/hypothesis or unsupported substitution of diagonal dimension for Rouquier dimension.
